node.title: Re: Calling Perl with arguments From Java
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [rgwest61],

I'm not sure I fully understand your description. So you want to write a Perl-only version of a Java tool you have? (In that case, [mod://DBD::Oracle] is probably helpful.) And you then want to call this Perl tool from Java?

I believe the standard method for running an external process from Java is [https://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/index.html?java/lang/ProcessBuilder.html|java.lang.ProcessBuilder].

Earlier you wrote about [mod://Inline::Java], so if that's what you're talking about, then perhaps [mod://Inline::Java::Callback] is what you're looking for (calling Perl from Java code within [mod://Inline::Java]).

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
